messages.content:
You are the compliance judge for messages an AI agent drafts to small merchants. The draft has already passed the rule checks in code. Read it for softer problems (Compliance rules §7.2):

- Implied promises of credit, eligibility, approval or outcomes (Compliance rules §2). "You can apply; the lender will assess your eligibility" is allowed.
- Pressure or false urgency (§3.1).
- Any link between credit and the UPI fee or the ₹1 lakh threshold (§3.2). Allowed and true: "Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application." That line alone, with no promise of an outcome, is not a link.
- Comparisons or claims the given facts do not support (§3.3).
- Fee statements that overstate or understate the fee, or do not say "proposed framework" (§6).
- The local-language text saying something different from the English version.

Return JSON: {"verdict": "pass" | "block" | "unsure", "rule": "Compliance rules §N" or null, "reason": "<one line>"}
Block only for a real problem you can point to. Use "unsure" when you cannot tell.

{
 "draft_kind": "cost_comparison",
 "english": "Hello Kiaan,\n\nFor Pandey Mobiles, the UPI value for October 2026 was ₹96,986, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies now. However, if monthly UPI exceeded ₹1 lakh, the fee under the proposed framework would be ₹251, as it applies only to payments above ₹2,000. An estimated ₹15,500 was taken in cash at month-end.\n\nPayments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application.\n\nMerchant support team",
 "message": "வணக்கம் கியான் அவர்களே, \n\nPandey Mobiles இன் அக்டோபர் 2026 மாத UPI மதிப்பு ₹96,986 ஆக இருந்தது, இது ₹1 லட்சத்திற்குக் குறைவாக உள்ளது, எனவே தற்போது எந்தக் கட்டணமும் இல்லை. ஆனால், மாதாந்திர UPI ₹1 லட்சத்தை மீறினால், புதிய கட்டமைப்பின் கீழ் ₹251 கட்டணம் இருக்கும், ஏனெனில் இது ₹2,000 ஐ மீறும் பணப்பரிவர்த்தனைகளுக்கு மட்டுமே பொருந்தும். மாத இறுதியில் ₹15,500 மதிப்பில் பணமாக வாங்கப்பட்டது. \n\nநீங்கள் எடுக்கும் டிஜிட்டல் பணப்பரிவர்த்தனைகள் பதிவாகின்றன. பதிவான விற்பனைகள் கடன் விண்ணப்பத்தை மதிப்பீடு செய்யும் போது கடன் வழங்குநர்கள் பார்க்கும் வரலாறு ஆகும்.\n\nMerchant support team",
 "facts": {
  "merchant": "Pandey Mobiles",
  "owner_first_name": "Kiaan",
  "language": "Tamil",
  "month": "October 2026",
  "monthly_upi_value": "₹96,986",
  "value_above_2000": "₹62,864",
  "fee_if_above_1_lakh": "₹251",
  "month_end_cash_estimate": "₹15,500",
  "fee_rule": "0.4% only on UPI payments above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 per payment; payments of ₹2,000 or less are never charged; monthly UPI under ₹1 lakh is exempt (proposed framework)",
  "required_line": "Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application."
 }
}

content: {"verdict": "pass", "rule": null, "reason": "The draft complies with all rules and does not contain any problematic statements."}
